subject: Fix slow-clocksource check for HW monotonic clock and non-x86 advisories (#4272)
reason: The entire diff is confined to checkClocksource() in src/syscheck.c, which is only executed by the 'valkey-server --check-system' diagnostic subcommand (server.c:7611). It is never called during normal server startup, by any command, or by any of the four tools valkey.action.tools can run (valkey-cli, valkey-benchmark, valkey-check-rdb, valkey-check-aof), so no installed or writable experiment can invoke it.
